messages.author: cb25d91fd630a4e5
messages.subject: Re: legend
parts:
Here's a couple self-contained examples (a little bit less extreme
than Felipe's example, but you can still see that the bounding box of
the legend overlaps with the panel/strips):


ggplot(mtcars,aes(x=disp,y=mpg,colour=cyl))+
geom_point()+
opts(
legend.background=theme_rect(fill='red',colour='white')
, panel.background=theme_rect()
)

ggplot(mtcars,aes(x=disp,y=mpg,colour=cyl))+
geom_point()+
facet_grid(vs~.)+
opts(
legend.background=theme_rect(fill='red',colour='white')
, strip.background=theme_rect()
)

--
Mike Lawrence
